title: In the Toffee Jar
subtitle: She licked the glittering wing dust from her hand, recalling the tooth fairy's taste as it burst in her mouth.

items.text: A Nightmare at Green Lake

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: My head, everywhere, hurts. Did I get pulled into pieces or ...

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Pi- … Pieces ...

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: No! Don't ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Blonney! You're awake.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I have just given you first aid for the wounds. For now, we will have to wait for Ms. Tooth Fairy to administrate a thorough treatment when she comes back.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't worry. She's very professional and skillful. You won't feel any pain in the process.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Am I ... am I in the cabin? Then I'm not dead. Good, I'm not dead.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You are safe. The critter is gone. Don't worry.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Follow me. Take a deep breath. Hold my hand. Another deep breath.
Blonney gradually calms down, yet her hands are still trembling.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Do you feel better now?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Thank you. I feel much better now.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Oh, Anne! Where's she? Did she get hurt?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We didn't find her in the woods. Wasn't she in Michael's car?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: No, she wasn't. She jumped off. She saw me being attacked by the critter and jumped out from the side window. Oh, no.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: The butcher, he must have taken Anne! Must … be with him. I … I saw him too! He was walking towards her!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Just like what would happen in a horror movie ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's okay. Here, take my hand.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We know where she is now, this is good. We will get her back safe and sound.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Okay, I … I understand …
The wooden door once again opens with squeaky noises.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ms. Tooth Fairy, you're back! Where is Michael?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: They have gone.
She takes a key out of her pocket and puts it on the table.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: We are not able to catch up and intercept their car. It crashed on the ... the edge of the woods in front of us.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Crashed on the edge of the woods? What do you mean?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I don't know, either. Their car was about to rush out of the woods, and then we heard a huge crushing sound.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: The front section was squeezed together, and the rear wheels were lifted in the air. And there was an explosion. Looks like the car ... was crashing into an invisible wall.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It happened right in front of us, too quick and too astonishing.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: We got to the car. The fire caused by the explosion was being extinguished by the rain. We found no one but this key.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is it yours, Blonney?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: No. Never seen it before.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I always have some decorations or a doll attached to the keychain. This one is rusty and too plain. It smells weird too, like dirt.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Anything special?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: No. Neither mark nor labels. We didn't find anything to match it in the car.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: First, "lone wolf," then the "people who failed to escape."

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Things are getting too complicated, but there's one thing that I am certain of.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: We are now caught in a dangerously and classically plotted horror movie.
After taking a break, they light a fire to warm the space.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: That means Anne jumped off the car in order to save Blonney from the critter's attack. Then she got lost.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: According to Blonney, the last thing she saw was the approaching butcher from the woods.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: She is in great danger. We must act swiftly to save her.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Also, we need to turn this cabin into a security base for the upcoming battles.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Horropedia and I will rescue Anne. He is a horror movie expert, and it will be of great help.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In the meantime, you and Sonetto stay here to take care of Blonney and to secure this room.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I will take good care of her.
The group splits into two halves. The one saying in the cabin starts to work.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Oh! This hurts!

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Please bear with me for a minute. The wounds caused by critters are prone to tetanus. I need to thoroughly sterilize them.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: How about some painkillers? Give me some!

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I'm very sorry. I don't have any with me.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You! Didn't you say her treatment wouldn't be painful?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I'm terribly sorry for what you're going through, but this is not the typical kind of treatment that we used to receive from her.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: How did she do it, then?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: She would ...
Sonetto looks at Tooth Fairy hesitantly until she sees a nod of permission.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: She would ask us to take the toothfairies, that is, those golden elves in the glass jar.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: They are effective in treating toothache and other oral diseases, but also can be used to reduce inflammation, stimulate wound healing, and relieve headaches.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Take ... You mean ... to eat ... this?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes. And it actually tastes pretty nice, like mint and flavored dried plum. It ... it just looks a bit unconventional.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You would go as far as to eat this shi- ...

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Please stretch your legs. I need to sterilize the inner thighs.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Aah ...!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ah ...

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ugh! Okay, fine. I will take that. Bring me the little elflings!

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Sorry, Blonney, you can't eat toothfairies as a treatment.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Why can't I? Of course, I can. I will just put it in my mouth and swallow with my eyes closed.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: This is not about you. It is my own rule of treatment.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I have specific treatments for humans and arcanists correspondingly.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Through our contact so far, I got to know that you don't consider yourself as an arcanist, and that's why I will not treat you as one.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Are you upset about what I said? I … I owe you an apology. I shouldn't have been rude to arcanists in front of you.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I know it hurt your feelings. I was ... not myself.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I chose to live amongst humans, chose to be their friends, to be a "different arcanist" ...

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I thought in this way I would be taken in as one of them. But, as you see, when things come to a critical moment, they ran away without me.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: It was my car that they drove to escape, and yet they called me a freak and left me here to die. Huh! Funny, isn't it?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Sad story. I feel sorry for you.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: But still, you can't take the toothfairies.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Is this a punishment for what I have done?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I can't feed you the toothfairies, only because you still think you are a human.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: You don't recognize the behavior of your human classmates but still want to be on their side and be one of them.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Okay.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: The wounds are packed.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Already? I … I didn't feel a thing.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I've applied Carbuncle growth promoter. It will paralyze, sedate, and accelerate your cell regeneration. Your wounds will close up in 30 minutes.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Isn't that a medicine for "arcanists"?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It is a prescription approved by the medicine examination supervised by Campbell. In this case, it doesn't violate my rule.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You could have applied this earlier and spared me the pain.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I don't rely on painkillers. I am an excellent doctor. Minimizing patients' pain is, of course, my forte.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: When kids can't suppress their pain, I normally sing for them to ease their pain.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You didn't sing for me. Was it because you didn't want to?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Maybe. I confess, what you did and said at first was really annoying.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Arcanists and humans always act as if they were of one merged entity, but we all know how lines have been drawn between their own people and the others.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: You grew up among humans, and you learned to look away from the truth as they did. Oh, but you do react better to the medicine for arcanists. Your blood is bringing you a good outcome. Look.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: In another half an hour, your wounds will be fully recovered. By then, you will be able to jump and run freely, as if you were never hurt.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: However you feel about your ancestry, it is helping you out.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: My wounds ... a good outcome?
Blonney, shocked by what she heard, watches Tooth Fairy wrapping up her devices and walking toward the stairs.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ms. Tooth Fairy, please wait.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: If what Mr. Horropedia has said is true, it's dangerous for us to split up. The three of us should stay together.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It will take another 25 minutes for her legs to fully recover.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: If the situation were to develop based on the rules of "horror movies," at this stage, I am safe. Don't worry about me.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I see. Have you also done a lot of research about this genre?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Hmm, not a lot. I just browsed the secret notebook left by Horropedia in the infirmary.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I covered him from the instructors to keep his notebook. Since then, we became friends.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Keep, keep things from the instructors. Did you do this a lot?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Not really. The rules were extremely strict. Except for Horropedia, I only had Vertin as a frequent guest.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: She pretended that she got a stomachache, lying in bed for half a class. She took many toffees when she left.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper faked her illness? Aah, and that also explains her toffees.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Heh, you didn't know that?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It seems I need to apologize to Vertin for letting out her secret.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: But thank goodness, you are on her side now. Our negligence didn't cause much damage.
